# Fuel & trip cost

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/fuel-cost/

Estimate fuel use and cost from a trip distance, vehicle economy and fuel price. Choose kilometers per liter or liters per 100 kilometers.

## How to use it

1. Enter the numbers, dates or units you want to compare.
2. Choose the calculation options and calculate.
3. Review the result together with the assumptions shown.

## Example

Estimate the fuel cost of a 200-kilometer trip and divide it among three travelers.

## Limits and checks

Enter your own current fuel price. Actual economy changes with traffic, terrain, load and driving style.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
